title: The Sunshine Slushie Family Game Night
description: A family game night, all from Sam's Club: a Nex Playground motion game console with its travel case, a Ninja SLUSHi frozen drink maker, a JBL PartyBox Club 120 speaker, Ello color changing kids tumblers and a Goldfish 3-pack.
intro: Winter break is two weeks long and somehow every kid in my life is bored by day three. So this is the big family gift that gets everybody off the couch: a motion game console where your body is the controller, a slushie machine so the snack table feels like an event, a party speaker that lights up and a stack of kids cups that change color when they're cold. Add a giant box of Goldfish and nobody's asking for screens. Well, a different screen.

sections.heading: The games
paragraphs: The Nex Playground and Travel Case, 2 in 1 Bundle: a small mint and yellow camera cube that sits under the TV and turns movement into the controller, plus a white zip travel case. The JBL PartyBox Club 120 Portable Party Speaker, with the light-up figure eight on the front and a handle on top.

sections.heading: The snack table
paragraphs: The Ninja SLUSHi 96oz. Professional Frozen Drink Maker, shown on the listing with a black SLUSHi tote. The Ello Kids 12-Ounce Color Changing Tumblers with Lids and Straws, 10 Pack, in Rainforest. And the Pepperidge Farm Goldfish Crackers, 22 oz., 3 pk., because game night runs on Goldfish.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The room, the sofa, the rug, the cart, the bowls and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
